title: Maintenance shift handoff note: what's running, what's down, what's pending
summary: A fictional handoff organized by operating state, owner and next decision.

blocks.heading: 14:00 handoff · example only
blocks.body: Incoming lead: Morgan. Outgoing lead: Casey. The first decision is whether Cell 2 can restart; it cannot until the unresolved fault is evaluated and the site’s release procedure is complete.

blocks.heading: What the next shift needs first
rows: Last checked 13:50; 40 consecutive parts within the process check
Intermittent axis fault at 12:42 and 13:15; alarm history saved
Maintenance lead: compare events and authorize next diagnostic step
Replacement sensor received; installation not started
Casey handed kit to Morgan; schedule during approved downtime
blocks.caption: Fictional operations note. It does not replace permits, isolation records or a restart authorization.

blocks.title: Cell 2: do not convert “reset” into “repaired”
blocks.body: No root cause is confirmed. Alarm reset briefly restored operation before the second event. Guarding, safety systems and isolation remain governed by the machine-specific procedure. Record their actual state in the handoff, not an assumption.
